key_insight: ASALT enables multi-agent transfer learning across source and target domains with mismatched observation and state dimensions by learning shared embeddings through adaptive state and observation alignment.
engineering_relevance: This is useful for building reusable MARL systems that can transfer policies and value functions across heterogeneous environments while reducing negative transfer and data requirements.
method: Uses observation-level adapters to map target observations into a shared latent space.
Uses state-level adapters to align target global states for critic/value transfer.
Transfers knowledge for both actors and critics across domains with different dimensionalities.
evidence_signal: Experiments on standard benchmark environments show improved sample efficiency and global return in cooperative settings compared with baselines.
watch_item: Performance depends on the degree of source-target mismatch, so the adapter design and domain gap should be checked carefully before deployment.
paper_title: ASALT: Adaptive State Alignment for Lateral Transfer in Multi-agent Reinforcement Learning
